rssPortal.title: RSS across devices
rssPortal.description: These source and article records sync according to your policy. They do not enable fetching or automatically import existing subscriptions or article bodies.
rssPortal.confirmDelete: Delete this shared record? Downloaded article bodies on this device will remain.
rssPortal.failed: The record remains on this device; synchronization has not completed.
rssPortal.unknown: Sync has not initialized. This change stays on this device; edit and save it again after initialization to sync.
rssPortal.blocked: Changes from before the cloud reset remain on this device. Edit and save explicitly to upload again.

settings.storageModuleRssDesc: Explicitly managed source and item metadata; existing subscriptions are not automatically synced or enabled

settings.storageSwitchFailed: Could not save the policy. Your local choice remains active.
settings.storagePendingSave: Your choice has not been saved. Local sync restrictions stay active; retry or explicitly choose Cloud.
settings.storageIdentityRequired: Sign in again to confirm this account before changing its pending local choice.
settings.storageLocalNotSaved: Your local choice could not be saved reliably. Retry before closing or refreshing the app; otherwise sync restrictions may be lost.
settings.storageIntentUnavailable: Local privacy choices cannot be read safely. Uploads are paused. Retry reading when storage is available.
settings.storageNotesResetPending: Cloud deletion is unconfirmed. Originals remain on this device and uploads are paused. Select Local only again to retry deletion.
settings.storageNotesResetBlocked: Cloud sync was reset. Local originals and old operations are retained; old operations will not upload automatically. Save the note again to upload it.
settings.storageNotesInitPending: Cloud sync initialization is incomplete. Notes remain on this device. After connecting, save any notes you want to upload again.
settings.storageNotesSyncPending: Notes have not synced; your data is saved on this device. Check the connection, device clock, note format or size, then save the note again. ENEX imports do not support sync yet.
settings.storageModuleResetPending: The cloud clear for {module} is unconfirmed. Local originals are retained and uploads paused. Select Local only again to retry.
settings.storageModuleResetBlocked: The cloud copy of {module} was reset. Local content and old operations are retained. Save the content again to upload it.
settings.storageModuleInitPending: Sync initialization for {module} is pending. Local content is retained. After connecting, save the content you want to upload again.
settings.storageModuleSyncPending: {module} has not synced. Local content is retained. Check your network, device time or content size, then save again.
settings.storageLocalCloudUnavailable: Cloud writes and sync are disabled. Existing server-backed mail and feed features may be unavailable.
settings.storageNativeEmailStopUnconfirmed: Background email on this device could not be confirmed stopped. Existing tasks may still access the cloud. Re-enabling is blocked; please retry. If you use an older Android app, update it and retry.
settings.storageNativeEmailStopLimits: Requests already sent cannot be recalled. If device storage fails, the disabled state may not survive a restart.
settings.storageLoadFailed: Policy service unreachable; using cached policy. Uploads pause if no valid cache is available.
